name: Kaai 4 Braai Restaurant
description: An authentic South African braai (BBQ) experience right on the water's edge. Enjoy traditional dishes, meat straight off the fire, and a laid-back sandy floor atmosphere.

name: Delfino's Restaurant
description: Iconic seaside dining at The Point. Famous for their fantastic pizzas, fresh seafood, and sweeping ocean views where you can often spot dolphins.

name: Blue Shed Coffee Roastery
description: A quirky, vintage-styled coffee shop offering artisan roasted coffee, fresh baked goods, and a cozy atmosphere perfect for morning relaxations.

name: Baruch's Coffee Roastery
description: Authentic Israeli-style coffee roastery and bakery. Known for their incredible middle-eastern inspired breakfasts, fresh bagels, and premium coffee blends.
